extracted.intended_audience: regulatory practitioners, lawyers, researchers, and members of the public who need an index of CFR titles and their update status
extracted.subtask_description: A machine-readable index of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) titles giving title number, name, most recent amendment/issue dates, up-to-date status, and whether the title is reserved. Useful for locating the correct CFR title for rulemaking, notice-and-comment, or legal research.
